history.content: I'm on way too many newsletters. Fix it.

Here's the lay of the land from the last two weeks of promo mail:

1. Morning Brew · "Daily brew" · daily newsletter

2. Substack · "12 newsletters waiting" · you're subscribed to 12 Substacks

So it's really one daily brew plus a dozen Substacks. Two ways to cut this down:

1. Tell me which ones to keep and I'll unsubscribe you from the rest (I'll need to go into each one's site to do it).

2. Or the low effort move: keep the Substacks but kill Morning Brew, since Substack already bundles everything into one digest.

Which ones are you actually reading? Name the keepers and I'll start cutting.
